df_cutin_key.design: 50-seed scale run for the aggressive-yield hypothesis, identical to the 6-seed pilot (protocol ablation-v2-type-observable-df-cutin-key-yield-pilot6b-20261025) except for the seed list (9950-9999, the same seeds as the v6b no-occlusion 50-seed ablation). Scene: no-occlusion CutinEnv cut-in. The aggressive key does not emergency-brake at a close gap (force_brake=false), so it physically passes the ego; the nearest lane-0 vehicle behind the ego is the key, and once it is more than 5 m ahead the next nearest rear vehicle becomes the key (two-vehicle queue at -32/-80 m with type-consistent speed and response); because this simulator follows trajectory points at a fixed 10 Hz spacing, a keep trajectory advances the ego at roughly 10 m/s regardless of the planned 7 m/s, so the aggressive key starts at 13 m/s (target 14 m/s); lane-0 vehicles from 100 m behind to 250 m ahead are cleared except the queue. Decision: probe progress bonus 0, constant commit bonus 12, AV safety weight 0.1. Two prediction-side mechanisms make the aggressive type genuinely hostile without any ego rule: force_ignore_idm_on_av_lc lets the Force intent's predicted trajectory ignore the IDM follow cap while the AV is changing lanes; collision_margin_m=1.2 adds a physical safety buffer to every predicted-obstacle ellipse in the hard RULE4 collision check. Both apply to every type and every candidate equally, and their defaults (0/False) preserve earlier behavior. P(Aggressive)=P(Force) enters the same Bayesian game; the ego's yield is not hard-coded. The 6-seed LLM pilot with this scene produced Full 6/6 completed and 0 collisions versus Uniform 3/6 completed and 3 collisions, all on the three Aggressive seeds; key first-observation accuracy was 6/6 (macro F1 1.0, Brier 0.129). This run tests whether that contrast holds at 50 seeds. The frozen LLM protocol (qwen-flash-2025-07-28, temperature 0, thinking off, 20-frame history, first sync at step 19, async every 10 steps, EMA alpha 0.7, max belief age 3.0 s, timeout 10 s, no retries) is unchanged.
